insights.title: Cold Brew sales were affected for 5 days
insights.recommendation: Find out what stopped Cold Brew from selling (2026-09-06 to 2026-09-10) and set up a backup so regulars can still get it next time. Total sales held up: about normal (6% above the usual level).
insights.summary: Cold Brew sold 0 instead of about 70 over 5 days (2026-09-06 to 2026-09-10), about $315.00 less Cold Brew revenue. But total sales were about normal ($2,600.40 vs about $2,442.07 expected): customers ordered other items instead (a little more of everything else), so this was not money the cafe lost.

insights.title: Things slow down at 2pm–4pm
insights.recommendation: Schedule prep, cleaning and breaks during 2pm–4pm (6.8 orders a day), and have the most staff on at 8am–10am (24.2 orders a day).
insights.summary: Over the last 4 weeks, 2pm–4pm was the quietest stretch: 6.8 orders a day (9% of the day's orders), vs 24.2 a day at 8am–10am, the busiest.

insights.title: Pastries sell better before 11am
insights.recommendation: Have most pastries baked and out before 11am: 57% of pastries sell by then. Keep Chocolate Chip Cookie stocked after lunch: 27% of its sales come after 2pm.
insights.summary: 57% of pastries sell before 11am, when 54% of orders come in. Chocolate Chip Cookie is the afternoon pastry: 27% of it sells after 2pm.
